(NYSE: CCI) ("Crown Castle") today reported results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and updated its full year 2026 Outlook, as reflected in the table below. "In the third quarter, we improved margins and strengthened our customer relationships including the completion of an agreement with a key customer," said Chris Hillabrant, Crown Castle’s President and Chief Executive Officer. "As we look ahead, we remain focused on becoming a best-in-class U.S. tower operator by driving additional operating efficiencies, modernizing our systems, and increasing our land ownership under our towers. We believe our pure-play U.S. tower strategy, disciplined capital allocation framework, and investment-grade balance sheet position us to deliver attractive long-term shareholder returns." HIGHLIGHTS FROM THE QUARTER • Site rental revenues. Organic Contribution to Site Rental Billings in the third quarter 2026 was $35 million, or 3.5% organic growth, excluding an unfavorable $61 million and $5 million impact from DISH Terminations and Sprint Cancellations, respectively. Organic growth increases to 3.8% if DISH revenues are excluded from prior year site rental billings, which compares to 4.1% in the third quarter 2025 on a comparable basis. Site rental revenues were negatively impacted by a $3 million decrease in amortization of prepaid rent and a $14 million decrease in straight-lined revenues, resulting in a decline in site rental revenues of $46 million, or 4.5%, from third quarter 2025 to third quarter 2026. The following table outlines the components of Organic Contribution to Site Rental Billings, excluding the impact of DISH and the Sprint Cancellations, and the respective percentage of prior period site rental billings, excluding prior year site rental billings to DISH. (c) Amounts have been recast to exclude DISH contributions to the components of Organic Contribution to Site Rental Billings. • Net income (loss). Net income (loss) for the third quarter 2026 was $283 million compared to $323 million for the third quarter 2025. • Adjusted EBITDA. Third quarter 2026 Adjusted EBITDA was $673 million compared to $718 million for the third quarter 2025. The decrease in the quarter was primarily a result of the lower contribution from site rental revenues discussed above and lower services contribution, partially offset by lower selling, general and administrative expenses. The pathway to possible. CrownCastle.com News Release continued: Page 3 • AFFO and AFFO per share. Third quarter 2026 AFFO was $530 million, or $1.24 per share, representing increases of 8% and 11%, respectively, from third quarter 2025. The increase in the quarter was primarily a result of decreases in interest expense and outstanding common stock resulting from the use of proceeds from the sale of our Fiber and Small Cell businesses partially offset by the changes in revenue discussed above. • Capital expenditures. Capital expenditures during the third quarter were $66 million, composed of $58 million of discretionary capital expenditures and $8 million of sustaining capital expenditures. The $66 million of capital expenditures increased 57% compared to $42 million of capital expenditures from continuing operations during third quarter 2025, primarily driven by a $24 million increase in land capital expenditures. • Common stock dividend. During the quarter, Crown Castle paid common stock dividends of approximately $452 million in the aggregate, or $1.0625 per common share, unchanged on a per share basis compared to the same period a year ago. "We are increasing our full year 2026 guide for Adjusted EBITDA by $25 million and AFFO by $5 million to reflect higher ground lease buyout activity, additional operational efficiencies, and the impact of a customer agreement," said Sunit Patel, Crown Castle’s Chief Financial Officer. "In the quarter we acquired an outstanding residual economic interest on a subset of our tower sites and extended the term of a significant customer on those sites. We ended the third quarter with a strong balance sheet, including 97% fixed rate debt, a weighted average debt maturity of approximately 7 years, and approximately $3.9 billion of availability under our revolving credit facility." OUTLOOK This Outlook section contains forward-looking statements, and actual results may differ materially. Information regarding potential risks which could cause actual results to differ from the forward-looking statements herein is set forth below and in Crown Castle's filings with the SEC. The following table sets forth Crown Castle's current full year 2026 Outlook, which includes the following key updates from the previous Outlook issued on July 22, 2026: • We expect to finish the year towards the bottom end of the $60 million to $70 million full year 2026 Outlook range for core leasing activity. • A $20 million increase to site rental revenues from higher straight-lined revenues related to contractual term extensions. • A $5 million decrease in site rental cost of operations from higher ground lease buyout activity and additional operational efficiencies. • A $40 million increase in discretionary capital expenditures from higher ground lease buyout activity. A listen only live audio webcast of the conference call, along with supplemental materials for the call, can be accessed on the Crown Castle website at https://investor.crowncastle.com. Participants may join the conference call by dialing 833-816-1115 (Toll Free) or 412-317-0694 (International) at least 30 minutes prior to the start time. All dial-in participants should ask to join the Crown Castle call. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Investor page of Crown Castle's website until end of day, Thursday, October 21, 2027.
